title: Constitutive Origin of Hamiltonian Degeneracy in Nonlinear Electrodynamics with Spontaneous Lorentz Symmetry Breaking
summary: In Plebański nonlinear electrodynamics with spontaneous Lorentz symmetry breaking, nontrivial magnetic backgrounds are selected by stationary points of an effective Hamiltonian. Previous branchwise Hamiltonian analyses showed that this same stationarity requirement coincides with the vanishing of the determinant of the Poisson-bracket matrix among the second-class constraints, but the structural origin of this coincidence was not manifest.
